layman_headline: Current positions are slightly green — patience is the play while the market finds direction.
layman_explanation: We're holding two positions right now: Solana (up 1.1%) and Chainlink (up 1.5%). Both are moving in the right direction but haven't hit their profit targets yet. The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' zone but sentiment is slowly improving from last week. There aren't any compelling new trades to open right now — the swing candidates are either wildly overbought (Bitway with RSI 93), stablecoins, or lack enough technical data to justify an entry.
layman_action: Keep holding SOL and LINK. Both positions have defined stop-losses and are trending toward their targets. No new buys this cycle — wait for a cleaner setup with better risk/reward.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool this cycle is poor quality. BTW (RSI 93, +168% 7d) is a textbook blow-off top to avoid. VELVET and PIEVERSE lack sufficient technical data (no RSI, no MACD, no SMA context) and are low-liquidity names. Gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) are declining and don't fit swing trading profiles. MON has no momentum. Our existing LINK and SOL positions are both in early profit with intact setups — LINK targeting $10.90 (12.4% upside from entry) and SOL targeting $85 (11.6% upside). BTC dominance at 56.5% is headwind for alts but the improving Fear & Greed trend (34.9 weekly avg → 46 current) suggests rotation back into risk assets could accelerate.
